name: Sengoku unification pact on the test map: the AI joins only when allied, pooled castles, only the lead wins

steps.code: local limit=GameConfiguration.GetValue('GAME_TURN_LIMIT'); if limit~=DB.MakeHash('TURNLIMIT_NONE') then error('turn limit not NONE: '..tostring(limit)) end; return 'turn limit NONE after Create Game setup'

local plots={['6,5']=true,['25,5']=true,['6,14']=true,['25,14']=true}; local function castle(city) return plots[city:GetX()..','..city:GetY()]==true end; local total=0; local owned=0; for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do for _,city in Players[owner]:GetCities():Members() do if castle(city) then total=total+1; if owner==0 then owned=owned+1 end end end end; if total~=4 or total-owned~=2 then error('initial castles '..owned..'/'..total) end; if not Game.IsVictoryEnabled('VICTORY_JAC_SENGOKU_UNIFICATION') then error('unification victory disabled') end; if Game.GetWinningTeam()~=nil then error('winner at start') end; return 'registered=4, two held by Date'

local date=nil; for id=0,PlayerManager.GetWasEverAliveCount()-1 do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_DATE' then date=id end end; if not date then error('Date missing') end; local ashina=nil; for id=0,PlayerManager.GetWasEverAliveCount()-1 do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASHINA' then ashina=id end end; if not ashina then error('Ashina missing') end; JAC_RequestPact('Propose',date); return 'Oda proposes to Date'

condition.code: local date=nil; for id=0,PlayerManager.GetWasEverAliveCount()-1 do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_DATE' then date=id end end; if not date then error('Date missing') end; local ashina=nil; for id=0,PlayerManager.GetWasEverAliveCount()-1 do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASHINA' then ashina=id end end; if not ashina then error('Ashina missing') end; return Players[0]:GetProperty('JAC_UNIFICATION_PACT_RESULT')=='NOT_ALLIED' and Game:GetProperty('JAC_UNIFICATION_PACT_LEAD_'..date)==nil

steps.code: local date=nil; for id=0,PlayerManager.GetWasEverAliveCount()-1 do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_DATE' then date=id end end; if not date then error('Date missing') end; local ashina=nil; for id=0,PlayerManager.GetWasEverAliveCount()-1 do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASHINA' then ashina=id end end; if not ashina then error('Ashina missing') end; local plots={['6,5']=true,['25,5']=true,['6,14']=true,['25,14']=true}; local function castle(city) return plots[city:GetX()..','..city:GetY()]==true end; local capital=Players[date]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); local moved=nil; for _,city in Players[date]:GetCities():Members() do if castle(city) and city:GetID()~=capital:GetID() then moved=city end end; if not moved then error('Date castle to move missing') end; CityManager.TransferCity(moved,ashina); local a,b=Players[0]:GetDiplomacy(),Players[date]:GetDiplomacy(); a:SetHasMet(date); b:SetHasMet(0); a:SetHasDeclaredFriendship(date,true); b:SetHasDeclaredFriendship(0,true); a:SetHasAllied(date,true); if not a:HasAllied(date) then error('Oda and Date not allied') end; return 'Ashina holds one castle; Oda and Date allied'

local date=nil; for id=0,PlayerManager.GetWasEverAliveCount()-1 do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_DATE' then date=id end end; if not date then error('Date missing') end; local ashina=nil; for id=0,PlayerManager.GetWasEverAliveCount()-1 do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASHINA' then ashina=id end end; if not ashina then error('Ashina missing') end; JAC_RequestPact('Propose',date); return 'Oda proposes to Date'

condition.code: local date=nil; for id=0,PlayerManager.GetWasEverAliveCount()-1 do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_DATE' then date=id end end; if not date then error('Date missing') end; local ashina=nil; for id=0,PlayerManager.GetWasEverAliveCount()-1 do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASHINA' then ashina=id end end; if not ashina then error('Ashina missing') end; return Players[0]:GetProperty('JAC_UNIFICATION_PACT_RESULT')=='JOINED' and Game:GetProperty('JAC_UNIFICATION_PACT_LEAD_'..date)==0 and Game:GetProperty('JAC_UNIFICATION_PACT_LEAD_0')==0

steps.code: local capital=Players[0]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); if capital:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_JAC_PACT_UNIFIED'].Index) then error('pact marked with 3 of 4 castles') end; if Game.GetWinningTeam()~=nil then error('winner while Ashina holds a castle') end; return 'pact holds 3 of 4 castles; no winner'

local date=nil; for id=0,PlayerManager.GetWasEverAliveCount()-1 do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_DATE' then date=id end end; if not date then error('Date missing') end; local ashina=nil; for id=0,PlayerManager.GetWasEverAliveCount()-1 do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASHINA' then ashina=id end end; if not ashina then error('Ashina missing') end; local plots={['6,5']=true,['25,5']=true,['6,14']=true,['25,14']=true}; local function castle(city) return plots[city:GetX()..','..city:GetY()]==true end; local last=nil; for _,city in Players[ashina]:GetCities():Members() do if castle(city) then last=city end end; if not last then error('Ashina castle missing') end; CityManager.TransferCity(last,date); return 'Ashina castle handed to Date (pact partner)'

local human=Game.GetLocalPlayer(); AutoplayManager.SetTurns(1); AutoplayManager.SetReturnAsPlayer(human); AutoplayManager.SetObserveAsPlayer(PlayerTypes.NONE); AutoplayManager.SetActive(true); return true

condition.code: local date=nil; for id=0,PlayerManager.GetWasEverAliveCount()-1 do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_DATE' then date=id end end; if not date then error('Date missing') end; local ashina=nil; for id=0,PlayerManager.GetWasEverAliveCount()-1 do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASHINA' then ashina=id end end; if not ashina then error('Ashina missing') end; local winner,v=Game.GetWinningTeam(); return winner==Players[0]:GetTeam() and winner~=Players[date]:GetTeam() and v~=nil and GameInfo.Victories[v]~=nil and GameInfo.Victories[v].VictoryType=='VICTORY_JAC_SENGOKU_UNIFICATION'
